name: Wildcard Heroes get the 6% melee crit reduction 991293 from stock tank stances, and from Righteous Fury only while Paladin Protection talents lead
contract: A Hero (class 10, the Wildcard class) holding Defensive Stance (71), Bear Form (5487) or Dire Bear Form (9634) gets spell 991293 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_MELEE_CRIT_CHANCE -6, absolute daze immunity) like a Warrior or Druid. Righteous Fury (25780, Reborn 1125780) grants it only while the Hero's learned Paladin talent ranks of the active spec put Protection (TalentTab 383, tab page 1) ahead of Holy (382, page 0) and Retribution (381, page 2), with the tie rule of Player::GetMostPointsTalentTree: the lower page wins. Wildcard cards learn the Talent.dbc rank spells, so the scenario learns Redoubt (1421: 20127, 20130) and the Holy talent Spiritual Focus (1432: 20205) directly; a Hero holding Righteous Fury is resynced once per game second, because a higher talent rank learned over a lower one fires no learn hook, and Redoubt applies no aura without a shield, so the talent steps allow 2000 ms. 991293 follows through a relog. The attacker carries QA aura 25848 (+10 crit) so the 0 clamp cannot hide the -6.

steps.label: SETUP: no crit reduction for the Hero before a stance
SETUP: the attacker can daze the Hero outside a stance
Defensive Stance grants 991293 to a Hero
Defensive Stance lowers the Hero's melee crit chance taken by 6 points
Defensive Stance makes the Hero immune to daze
Leaving Defensive Stance removes 991293 from the Hero
Bear Form grants 991293 to a Hero
Leaving Bear Form removes 991293 from the Hero
Dire Bear Form grants 991293 to a Hero
Leaving Dire Bear Form removes 991293 from the Hero
SETUP: Righteous Fury is up on the Hero
Righteous Fury without Paladin talents grants the Hero no 991293
SETUP: Redoubt rank 1 is learned
A Protection talent card makes Righteous Fury grant the Hero 991293
Protection Righteous Fury lowers the Hero's melee crit chance taken by 6 points
Protection Righteous Fury makes the Hero immune to daze
SETUP: Spiritual Focus rank 1 is learned
Holy tying Protection takes 991293 away from the Hero
SETUP: Redoubt rank 2 is learned
Redoubt rank 2 puts Protection ahead of Holy and grants 991293
SETUP: Righteous Fury survives the Hero's relog
991293 follows Protection Righteous Fury through the Hero's relog
SETUP: Redoubt rank 2 is forgotten
Forgetting Redoubt rank 2 ties Holy again and removes 991293
SETUP: Spiritual Focus is forgotten
Forgetting the Holy talent lets Protection lead and grants 991293
Dropping Righteous Fury removes 991293 from the Hero
Reborn Righteous Fury grants 991293 to a Protection Hero
